shared_elements: low relief carving on a flat stone surface
horizontal register bands framing figural content
repeated row of similar motifs along a band
justification: Both surfaces present low-relief figures in profile organised into horizontal registers, with a repeated row of like motifs running along an upper band, which is the most specific shared trait. But the content differs sharply: A shows a naturalistic procession of clothed human tribute-bearers leading a camel with a rosette border, while B shows schematic, isolated animals (crouching feline-like beast, birds, a snake-like sinuous form) and abstract loop/H-shaped signs with no human figures or narrative procession.
